note: Run by the Highwood Lions Club for the Town of High River in George Lane Memorial Park, beside the Highwood River among cottonwoods and within walking distance of downtown shopping and restaurants. Showers and the sani-dump are free; an overnight group site is also rented. --Claude
summary: Operator pages confirm C$40 GST-included, C$5 extra adult, C$5 reservation fee and phone booking (now manual, tax included added); season/sites/hookups not on the operator pages, left; note trimmed of field repeats.
flags: Ownership local confirmed: 'OPERATED BY THE HIGHWOOD LIONS CLUB ON BEHALF OF THE TOWN OF HIGH RIVER'.
Google Maps 4.6 stars, 644 reviews, phone +1 403-652-2529 (matches), website georgelanecampground.ca (200).

Pin 50.57850,-113.87560 is at the park entrance road off Macleod Trail; Google 50.5784315,-113.8751605 (~35 m) - confirmed. Sites are under cottonwood canopy; the Highwood River is ~250 m+ from the pin; kept not waterfront.
Cancellation: 'Long weekends: 10 days notice or three nights will be charged' - a cancellation rule, not written as a minimum stay.
Season (05-01 to 09-30), sites (57, pull-through) and hookups (30) rest on the CampLife listing description; the operator's own pages do not state them, so left as stored.
